description:
EDIReader is a lightweight, flexible EDI parser written in pure Java,
        supporting X12, EDIFACT, and HL7. It has processed millions of transactions
        across diverse industries, platforms, products, and custom integrations.
        EDIReader also provides the parsing core for the EDIReader Framework,
        which adds EDIWriter, model-driven validation, support for TRADACOMS,
        and other integration capabilities.
